measures.definition: Rated non domestic properties on the list
measures.notes_common_to_every_row: counts rounded to 10 by the VOA

measures.definition: Total rateable value of those properties

$meta.publisher: Valuation Office Agency; Burnley Borough Council; MHCLG
$meta.table: VOA stock of properties, tables SOP3 to SOP7; the council's ratepayer file of 27 July 2026; NNDR3 2025-26
$meta.edition: VOA stock of properties at 31 March 2026
$meta.citation: VOA (2026) Non-domestic rating: stock of properties, 31 March 2026
$meta.vintage: VOA stock at 31 March each year; the 2026 list took effect on 1 April 2026
$meta.caveat: Aggregates only: the VOA download is not under the Open Government Licence for republication row by row. Each rating list (2017, 2023, 2026) resets rateable values to rents at a new valuation date, so a change across lists reflects rents as well as the stock of premises. A ratepayer account is not a business.
$meta.next_release: the VOA stock of properties at 31 March 2027
$meta.rules: No company or person is named. No estimate is shown as fact. Derived figures carry their arithmetic.
